ready.oewn-01936911-a.label: positive
ready.oewn-01936911-a.tone: The plain word - preparation finished, with nothing left to do before starting.

at_the_ready.oewn-01937433-s.label: positive
at_the_ready.oewn-01937433-s.tone: Held poised for the moment it is wanted, which puts the weight on the waiting rather than the preparing.

fit.oewn-01937602-s.label: positive
fit.oewn-01937602-s.tone: Inclination rather than preparation - the disposition is there, and nothing has been made ready.

primed.oewn-01937602-s.label: positive
primed.oewn-01937602-s.tone: Someone did the preparing, and did it deliberately - the readiness was loaded in.

set.oewn-01937602-s.label: positive
set.oewn-01937602-s.tone: Flat and final; the arrangement is fixed and all that remains is the signal.

in_order.oewn-01937916-s.label: positive
in_order.oewn-01937916-s.tone: Readiness as tidiness - each thing in its place, measured against a standard of proper arrangement.

prompt.oewn-01938075-s.label: positive
prompt.oewn-01938075-s.tone: Praise for the speed of the response and for the willingness behind it.

ripe.oewn-01938223-s.label: positive
ripe.oewn-01938223-s.tone: Readiness arrived at by itself rather than assembled, and it brings eagerness with it.

waiting.oewn-01938342-s.label: positive
waiting.oewn-01938342-s.tone: Patient and unexcited - it stresses that the readiness persists, not that it is keen.

ready_and_waiting.oewn-01938342-s.label: positive
ready_and_waiting.oewn-01938342-s.tone: The doubled phrase makes a small boast of it: not merely available but conspicuously so.

inaccurate.oewn-00023420-a.label: negative
inaccurate.oewn-00023420-a.tone: Measured and impersonal - it faults the result without accusing anyone of carelessness.

away.oewn-00023695-s.label: neutral
away.oewn-00023695-s.tone: A call, not a judgement; it locates the pitch and implies nothing about the pitcher.

outside.oewn-00023695-s.label: neutral
outside.oewn-00023695-s.tone: Purely positional, and plainer than *away* for saying where the pitch went.

faulty.oewn-00023894-s.label: negative
faulty.oewn-00023894-s.tone: Puts the error in the thing itself, as a defect it carries rather than a slip it made.

incorrect.oewn-00023894-s.label: negative
incorrect.oewn-00023894-s.tone: The cool formal verdict - it marks the failure against the rule and stops there.

wrong.oewn-00023894-s.label: negative
wrong.oewn-00023894-s.tone: Blunt and total; where *incorrect* grades a performance, this simply refuses it.

unfaithful.oewn-00024180-s.label: negative
unfaithful.oewn-00024180-s.tone: A failure of trust rather than of aim - what it names has let someone down.

wide.oewn-00024282-s.label: negative
wide.oewn-00024282-s.tone: The miss is measured as distance, and the word says nothing about how bad it was.

wide_of_the_mark.oewn-00024282-s.label: negative
wide_of_the_mark.oewn-00024282-s.tone: The full phrase makes the miss vivid, and can carry a note of mild ridicule that *wide* alone does not.

sound.oewn-02281076-a.label: positive
sound.oewn-02281076-a.tone: Solidity all the way through - it says the finances would survive inspection.

dependable.oewn-02281393-s.label: positive
dependable.oewn-02281393-s.tone: Financial safety framed as something others can rely on rather than something merely held.

dependable.oewn-00727525-a.label: positive
dependable.oewn-00727525-a.tone: Warmer than *reliable*: it suggests someone is doing the depending.

good.oewn-02281393-s.label: positive
good.oewn-02281393-s.tone: The mildest way to say the money is safe; it reassures without describing anything.

good.oewn-01052461-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

good.oewn-01052461-s.tone: The barest approval available - the result went the right way, and nothing more is claimed.

safe.oewn-02281393-s.label: positive
safe.oewn-02281393-s.tone: Concerned with what cannot be lost rather than with what might be gained.

secure.oewn-02281393-s.label: positive
secure.oewn-02281393-s.tone: Safety that has been arranged and held in place, not simply enjoyed.

healthy.oewn-02281587-s.label: positive
healthy.oewn-02281587-s.tone: Adds working order to safety: the money is not merely intact, it is doing its job.

solid.oewn-02281701-s.label: positive
solid.oewn-02281701-s.tone: Unglamorous, weighty approval - it promises holding rather than growth.

stable.oewn-02281838-s.label: positive
stable.oewn-02281838-s.tone: Praise for the absence of movement; what recommends it is that it does not swing.

accurate.oewn-00021803-a.label: positive
accurate.oewn-00021803-a.tone: The plain standard - conformity to the fact or the model, claimed without drama.

close.oewn-00022256-s.label: positive
close.oewn-00022256-s.tone: Fidelity with the gap admitted: it stays near the original rather than claiming to match it.

faithful.oewn-00022256-s.label: positive
faithful.oewn-00022256-s.tone: Fidelity treated as a kind of loyalty, as though the original were owed something.

dead-on.oewn-00022474-s.label: positive
dead-on.oewn-00022474-s.tone: Emphatic and informal; the admiration is for the aim as much as for the truth.

high-fidelity.oewn-00022717-s.label: positive
high-fidelity.oewn-00022717-s.tone: A technical grade rather than praise - it states how little the sound was altered.

hi-fi.oewn-00022717-s.label: positive
hi-fi.oewn-00022717-s.tone: The clipped form, and friendlier than *high-fidelity* for making the same claim.

surgical.oewn-00022889-s.label: positive
surgical.oewn-00022889-s.tone: Precision imagined as controlled and deliberate, cutting where intended and nowhere else.

straight.oewn-00022999-s.label: positive
straight.oewn-00022999-s.tone: Accuracy as honesty - nothing bent to suit anyone.

true.oewn-00023157-s.label: positive
true.oewn-00023157-s.tone: The flight went where it was aimed; the praise is for the aim, not for the truth of a statement.

dead_on_target.oewn-00023157-s.label: positive
dead_on_target.oewn-00023157-s.tone: Leaves no margin at all, and says so with some satisfaction.

veracious.oewn-00023315-s.label: positive
veracious.oewn-00023315-s.tone: Formal and exacting, treating precision as a virtue worth a long word.

right.oewn-00023315-s.label: positive
right.oewn-00023315-s.tone: The everyday word; it settles the matter without dwelling on how exact the exactness is.

fortunate.oewn-01051573-a.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

fortunate.oewn-01051573-a.tone: Approval with the surprise kept in - the good turn was neither earned nor expected.

better_off.oewn-01051901-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

better_off.oewn-01051901-s.tone: Comparative by construction; it means something only against the state someone was in before.

felicitous.oewn-01052105-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

felicitous.oewn-01052105-s.tone: Formal and pleased, treating the good fortune as elegant rather than merely welcome.

happy.oewn-01052105-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

happy.oewn-01052105-s.tone: Good fortune, not gladness - the luck sits in the outcome rather than in anyone's feelings.

fortuitous.oewn-01052286-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

fortuitous.oewn-01052286-s.tone: Insists on the chance: the good outcome arrived unsteered.

well.oewn-01052461-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

well.oewn-01052461-s.tone: Approval of how a thing turned out, judged by the ending rather than by the doing.

heaven-sent.oewn-01052675-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

heaven-sent.oewn-01052675-s.tone: Gratitude pitched high - the timing was so apt it invites the comparison the gloss makes.

providential.oewn-01052675-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

providential.oewn-01052675-s.tone: The graver word for that aptness, and it treats the rescue as intended rather than lucky.

miraculous.oewn-01052675-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

miraculous.oewn-01052675-s.tone: The strongest of the three: it does not merely note the aptness, it marvels at it.

lucky.oewn-01052909-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

lucky.oewn-01052909-s.tone: Plain and cheerful; it credits the chance and takes nothing away from the person.

well-off.oewn-01053051-s.label: positive

family.axis: lucky by chance → as if intended

well-off.oewn-01053051-s.tone: Fortune as a position someone occupies rather than an event that befell them.

best.oewn-00229099-a.label: positive
best.oewn-00229099-a.tone: The superlative itself - it closes the comparison rather than making one.

champion.oewn-00229617-s.label: positive
champion.oewn-00229617-s.tone: First place won against others; the contest comes with the praise.

prizewinning.oewn-00229617-s.label: positive
prizewinning.oewn-00229617-s.tone: The same first place, evidenced - it points at the award rather than at the quality.

high-grade.oewn-00229765-s.label: positive
high-grade.oewn-00229765-s.tone: Quality stated as a classification, the way a supplier states it.

top-quality.oewn-00229765-s.label: positive
top-quality.oewn-00229765-s.tone: The plainest strong claim about quality, with nothing held back and nothing specified.

top-grade.oewn-00229765-s.label: positive
top-grade.oewn-00229765-s.tone: Grading language again, pushed to the top of the scale rather than merely high on it.

first.oewn-00229886-s.label: positive
first.oewn-00229886-s.tone: Rank asserted flatly; it orders things and leaves the reason unsaid.

foremost.oewn-00229886-s.label: positive
foremost.oewn-00229886-s.tone: Formal and a little ceremonious - it places something ahead as a matter of standing.

world-class.oewn-00229886-s.label: positive
world-class.oewn-00229886-s.tone: Sets the comparison as wide as it will go, which is the whole of the compliment.

optimum.oewn-00230237-s.label: positive
optimum.oewn-00230237-s.tone: Best within limits - it carries the constraint it is best under wherever it goes.

optimal.oewn-00230237-s.label: positive
optimal.oewn-00230237-s.tone: The same bounded best, worn as an adjective of analysis rather than of praise.

primo.oewn-00230468-s.label: positive
primo.oewn-00230468-s.tone: Slangy and enthusiastic; the enthusiasm is the point, not the grading.

record-breaking.oewn-00230559-s.label: positive
record-breaking.oewn-00230559-s.tone: Best measured against history rather than against rivals present.

second-best.oewn-00230722-s.label: positive
second-best.oewn-00230722-s.tone: Praise with the loss inside it - a high place named together with the fact of not holding the highest.

superfine.oewn-00230819-s.label: positive
superfine.oewn-00230819-s.tone: A grading word for goods, pitched a step above *fine* and doing its work by the pitch alone.

crucial.oewn-00658802-a.label: positive
crucial.oewn-00658802-a.tone: Importance at its sharpest - something turns on this, and the turning is what the word insists on.

important.oewn-00658802-a.label: positive
important.oewn-00658802-a.tone: The broad word for weight, pressed here into service at crisis strength.

critical.oewn-00659155-s.label: positive
critical.oewn-00659155-s.tone: Names the turning point and the danger in it at once; the word is tense.

decisive.oewn-00659155-s.label: positive
decisive.oewn-00659155-s.tone: The same turning point read from the other side - what settles the matter rather than what threatens it.

life-and-death.oewn-00659407-s.label: positive
life-and-death.oewn-00659407-s.tone: The stakes stated as plainly as they can be, which is where the phrase gets its force.

life-or-death.oewn-00659407-s.label: positive
life-or-death.oewn-00659407-s.tone: The same stakes with the alternatives set against each other, which sharpens the choice.

pivotal.oewn-00659530-s.label: positive
pivotal.oewn-00659530-s.tone: Importance defined by what swings on it: everything else moves around this one point.

polar.oewn-00659530-s.label: positive
polar.oewn-00659530-s.tone: A fixed point that others take their bearings from, rather than one events turn on.

reliable.oewn-00727525-a.label: positive
reliable.oewn-00727525-a.tone: The plain word - trust earned by behaving the same way every time.

certain.oewn-00727841-s.label: positive
certain.oewn-00727841-s.tone: Reliability stated as an outcome - it will work, and the working is not in doubt.

sure.oewn-00727841-s.label: positive
sure.oewn-00727841-s.tone: The same confidence, shorter and more casual, and readier to be said out loud.

tested.oewn-00728040-s.label: positive
tested.oewn-00728040-s.tone: Trust backed by having been put through something rather than merely assumed.

time-tested.oewn-00728040-s.label: positive
time-tested.oewn-00728040-s.tone: The testing was long as well as real, and the length is the recommendation.

tried.oewn-00728040-s.label: positive
tried.oewn-00728040-s.tone: Quiet approval; it says only that the thing has been used and did not fail.

tried_and_true.oewn-00728040-s.label: positive
tried_and_true.oewn-00728040-s.tone: The pairing does the work - the testing and the verdict in one breath, with some fondness.

undeviating.oewn-00728164-s.label: positive
undeviating.oewn-00728164-s.tone: Steadiness treated as a virtue of principle, praising what refuses to bend.

preserved.oewn-00740790-a.label: positive
preserved.oewn-00740790-a.tone: Deliberate keeping - the condition held on purpose rather than by luck.

conserved.oewn-00740976-s.label: positive
conserved.oewn-00740976-s.tone: Keeping framed as husbandry: what matters is that nothing was spent or lost.

kept_up.oewn-00741059-s.label: positive
kept_up.oewn-00741059-s.tone: Ongoing effort, plainly said - the condition is the result of continued work.

maintained.oewn-00741059-s.label: positive
maintained.oewn-00741059-s.tone: The formal word for that same effort, crediting the routine rather than the care.

well-kept.oewn-00741059-s.label: positive
well-kept.oewn-00741059-s.tone: Approving of the result, and of whoever is answerable for it.

preservable.oewn-00741163-s.label: neutral
preservable.oewn-00741163-s.tone: A statement of possibility rather than of condition; nothing has been kept yet.

protected.oewn-00741247-s.label: positive
protected.oewn-00741247-s.tone: Safety supplied from outside - the word implies a guard as much as a state.

saved.oewn-00741247-s.label: positive
saved.oewn-00741247-s.tone: Rescue rather than upkeep: it implies the loss came close and did not happen.

retained.oewn-00741345-s.label: positive
retained.oewn-00741345-s.tone: Cool and possessive; it says something was not let go, without praising the holding.
